# Bison TradeWorks

> Cross-border sourcing and trade coordination between Mexico, the US, and Canada.

Bison TradeWorks connects US and Canadian buyers with vetted manufacturing partners in León, Mexico. One relationship covers vetting, pricing, quality control, freight, and customs.

## Services

- Contract manufacturing to brand specifications
- Ready-made goods for retailers
- Manufacturer placement with US/Canada buyers
- Import, freight, and customs coordination
- Quality control and ongoing account management
